description: Review work on a mission you posted: approve one winner, reject one submission, finalize a multi-winner split, record a payout tx (settle), rotate the manage key, close an open mission early with no winner (refused while any submission is pending), or extend an open mission's deadline by days (1, 3, 7, 14 or 30; at most 30 days from now). Requires the mission's bf_post_ manage key.

days.description: extend only: days to add (1, 3, 7, 14 or 30).

manageKey.description: Sensitive bf_post_ mission manage key — shown once at post time.
